newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-HAAGDOREN CALLED UP TO BELGIUM SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HAAGDOREN CALLED UP TO BELGIUM SQUAD.

text.p: Uncapped midfielder Filip Haagdoren became the fifth Lierse player to be called up for Belgium when national coach Georges Leekens named him on Sunday in his 18-man squad for the World Cup qualifier against Turkey on April 30.

Newcastle defender Philippe Albert and PSV Eindhoven striker Luc Nilis, who missed Belgium's last qualifier, a 2-1 win against Wales in Cardiff last month, are still out with knee and ankle injuries respectively.
Mouscron striker Mbo Mpenza is also out with an ankle problem.
Goalkeepers - Filip De Wilde (Sporting Lisbon), Philippe Vande Walle (Ekeren)
Defenders - Eric Van Meir (Lierse), Bart De Roover (Lierse), Olivier Doll (Anderlecht), Bertrand Crasson (Napoli), Geoffrey Claeys (Feyenoord), Vital Borkelmans (Club Brugge), Rudi Smidts (Antwerp)
Midfielders - Enzo Scifo (Monaco), Lorenzo Staelens (Club Brugge), Franky Van der Elst (Club Brugge), Dominique Lemoine (Espanol Barcelona), Nico Van Kerckhoven (Lierse), Filip Haagdoren (Lierse)
Strikers - Lokonda Mpenza (Mouscron), Luis Oliveira (Fiorentina), Bob Peeters (Lierse)
